title.hr: Rokovi čuvanja i obustava brisanja zbog spora
title.en: Retention periods and the legal hold

concept.hr: Brisanje po isteku roka je obveza; spor ga obustavlja, a kopije ga pamte
concept.en: Deleting when the period ends is a duty; a dispute holds it, backups remember

summary.hr: Postavi rokove čuvanja, pusti godine, dodaj spor i obustavu brisanja; vidi što je predugo čuvano, obrisano na vrijeme ili tijekom spora i što je u kopijama.
summary.en: Set retention periods, run the years, add a dispute and a legal hold; see what is kept too long, deleted on time or during the dispute, and still in backups.
